description: Agent tool use fixed end-to-end: AIP tool calls now reach the loop (they were silently dropped), the loop speaks the flat call contract with malformed-call filtering, empty replies retry briefly then say so instead of persisting silence, and kind-less saved configs heal automatically at read plus stamp on every save.
features: Fixed dropped tool calls: the AIP branch always set tool_calls [] — model tool calls now flow into execution and history.
Loop consumes the flat normalize() call contract and rebuilds OpenAI history in one place; nameless calls are dropped, never executed.
Empty replies retry (max 3) then persist a readable message instead of an empty bubble.
Kind healing: get_model fills missing kind at read (old records work with no re-save), saves stamp kind into the config, setup prompts require it.
Version synced to 0.12.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
